title: H-DenseUNet
paper_title: H-DenseUNet: Hybrid Densely Connected UNet for Liver and Tumor Segmentation From CT Volumes
core_mech: 先以 2D DenseUNet 学切片内细节，再将特征堆叠进 3D DenseUNet，并通过 hybrid feature fusion 联合预测。
core_mech_en: Extracts intra-slice features via a 2D DenseUNet, stacks them into a 3D DenseUNet, and fuses both via a hybrid feature fusion (HFF) layer.
input_desc: 高分辨率腹部 CT 体
output_desc: 肝脏/肿瘤 3D 分割概率体
output_en: 3D volumetric liver and tumor segmentation probability volume

source.title: H-DenseUNet

adapter.name: H-DenseUNet (hybrid fusion mechanism)
adapter.mechanism: 2D dense encoder/decoder features are stacked in slice order and fused with 3D dense features before a volumetric head.
limitations: Random initialization and synthetic data; no original benchmark result or pretrained capability is reproduced.
Compact independent hybrid port; staged ImageNet/LiTS training, original DenseNet depths and liver/tumor experiment are not reproduced.
